programmes.programName: Doctorate through the Doctoral School of Management Sciences
programmes.evidence: Current university Doctoral College PhD admission page lists ED SG Management Sciences among its thirteen doctoral schools and states enrolment leads to the national PhD diploma. The official school page independently confirms the exact Management Sciences school title and active doctoral specialties. One broad school-hosted PhD route is proposed, not a separate degree for each specialty.
limitations: The official school specialty list contains Supply Chain Management, which is not independently counted as an Operations title.

branches.conclusion: Doctoral School of Management Sciences formally hosts a PhD and lists five specialties; no second operations-titled specialty appears on the checked current school page.
Central current PhD school list includes Engineering–Production, but formal named fields within it have not yet been read; no Production Engineering route is inferred.
Central current PhD school list includes Informatics and Mathematics; its formal named doctoral research fields remain to check for Operations Research.
